<@1006995420439908363> I won't be a parrot and repeat everything already said, so I'll do it in my own words + biased opinions

1. The story mode access thing is very nice, but please don't let hp inflation affect the chapters later down the road! Not exactly everyone can predict you'll be greeted with some 20m hp boss at some point while on normal mode at that.. 

2. Rewards being added to make pvp mode/traphase more relevant is a good thing, but it feels a little weird to add them there for some reason.. It would've been better to try and make that mode relevant through other means, like an increase in pulls or silver gains<:Horla_cry:1357186646294138890> 

3. The Awakener customization frame thingy... I have a very strong opinion on this. I feel like it shouldn't be locked over +15 affinity, nor does it deserve the price it is tagged with. I understand the issues and whatnot with this, but making them different for each Awakener would at least somewhat explain the cost and means, rather than them being similar (example: for Castor and Pollux, they could have matching effects, Arachne could have spider webs, Jenkins little rats, etc etc) and super expensive all at the same time. 

4. As for covenants, I think it's fairly obvious every player here feels at least relatively the same way. So I won't go into it.

5. D-tide, oh man here we go.. While I like a good challenge, I feel like adding so many new things, like a nightmare mode and A6 and A7 will make it a little hard to play, even for people with already invested-in accounts. I do not wish for this game mode to be centered on how much we can spend until the unit is passable enough to clear the content. Additionally, I pray with my heart and soul and everything that I am, to not do hp inflation so early on. Not everyone has cleared the game mode with a full score. If veterans want a challenge, then let them have one. But casual players will definitely feel a lot more pressure on their shoulders as time goes on.

<@239715713042874379> Lets begin with the dzone changes, i think changing dtide as a mode is just a really weird choice overall since its the only thing that keeps players logging in and actually playing the game. Other modes need way more assistance so i would hope they dont get left for dead (especially pdive).
I think essentially adding 2 difficulty tiers is quite weird? why are we straight up ignoring the challenge even one new difficulty brings and adding another one on top? also the rewards allocation makes no sense why are the silver rewards less attainable now than before. Furthermore i dont understand the gnosis change and think its quite stupid, auto was removed for dtide since its an endgame gamemode to really test your skills and now we are able to use revives in it? what was the point of that is the game mode pro or con casual players?

I would also like a more general overhaul of train, madness is essentially a reset fest, trying to get the right relics/setup/bosses etc and just adding one new endboss feels like essentially 0 improvements to the mode with some random boss to now smash.

When it comes to the affinity system i like the changes in concept, especially being able to ear level up materials is really nice. What i dont think is acceptable is the cost of the items you need to buy. 50.000 currency is an INCREDIBLY out of touch amount to ask for and im wondering how you could possible end up at that number and think its okay. I also like the idea of a cosmetic for a character you love, but it having 0 individuality and essentially costing 250.000 currency is quite disappointing. Please reward your players more for their love of their characters. (i say this as someone whos starving for more corposant)

<@269375128339611648> Issues with the latest announcements:

1)    Having silver in the high score range is dumb and very frustrating for a new player. There is no way a new or casual player will ever get those scores in a reasonable amount of time. Especially when upgrading materials are limited as hell and also locked behind difficulty. It's so so so so unfriendly and has way too many barriers.

2) Its true that the silver actually equals very little rolls—but, it’s still a massive fear of missing out aspect that pushing this game into really unfriendly territory. The idea of limiting players by having upgrading materials locked behind extremely difficult content is already dumb and makes it SUPER hard for new players to catch up. Now adding fear of missing out into the mix and at a difficulty less than 10% of the player base is at is just an insult to the majority of the player base.

3) If there are to be rewards in the higher level it should be icons and banners/borders instead. Cosmetic and bragging rights is the way to go.

4) Difficulty should be scaled with the perceptive that Morimens is a game—not for treating Morimens like every player’s job or personal project (i.e., avoid adding tedious stuff within reason. Locking upgrade materials and silver behind millions of HP does not treat Morimens as a game.

5) There was a promise of "you won't need AA for end game content"—where did this perceptive go? Likewise, is Silver not counted as "meaningful rewards"? What the heck does "meaningful rewards" mean then? (see image)
